core/lequtis.py in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of core/lequtis.py at
that commit (git blob 1f3f3e5e77f879d87b716d4092417ec6b185f7d2, SHA-256
0229fe6348d3f10535f70c9f60e2ef983e789cd22baa5acd16d2c294a2ea41cc). The
schema-guard test runs this file to create a database, then checks that the
lequtis-os-kernel-3 kernel refuses that database and leaves it unchanged.
The test does not invoke git.
